item.skillcards.xiangyu.brief: Restore a small amount of health
item.skillcards.shamu.brief: Release black mist to blind enemies
item.skillcards.shamu.desc: Releases black mist around you, giving hunters within 30 blocks Slowness II (10s) and Blindness (10s)
item.skillcards.zhanfang.brief: Burst with energy and slightly strengthen yourself
item.skillcards.zhanfang.desc: Knocks back nearby hunters (5-6 blocks); grants Absorption X for 30 seconds
item.skillcards.shenfa.desc: Your next attack within 20 seconds deals exactly 20 damage
item.skillcards.hongxing.brief: Dash forward and gain slight speed
item.skillcards.hongxing.desc: Dashes ~12 blocks toward your view direction; grants Speed IV for 5 seconds
item.skillcards.dafuni.brief: Summon a horde of demon bunnies
item.skillcards.dafuni.desc: Summons 20 white bunnies that hunt hunters; each bunny splits into two after landing a hit, and hits inflict 3s of Hunger; all bunnies vanish after 120s
item.skillcards.qilin.desc: Precisely strikes hunters within 10 blocks with lightning, twice each (0.5s apart); each bolt adds a Scorch layer
item.skillcards.sanshi.brief: Randomly steal items from nearby enemies
item.skillcards.sanshi.desc: Randomly steals an item from a hunter's inventory within 300 blocks
item.skillcards.mangdian.desc: Jams the hunters' tracking compass for 60 seconds; removes your own glowing (restored after); grants self Invisibility (30s)
item.skillcards.yasiti.desc: Randomly teleports self to a location more than 200 and less than 300 blocks away
item.skillcards.zuzhou.brief: Greatly boost attack, at the cost of max health
item.skillcards.zuzhou.desc: Grants Strength IV for 60 seconds; max health is halved during the effect
item.skillcards.shengshu.brief: Lasting regeneration, at the cost of attack damage
item.skillcards.shengshu.desc: Grants Regeneration III for 60 seconds; also Weakness I during the effect
item.skillcards.chilin.desc: Rapidly drains 20 health in chunks (never lethal), granting Speed II, Strength II, Night Vision, Haste III and Jump Boost I for 30 seconds
item.skillcards.beneng.brief: Sense the movements of hunters in range
item.skillcards.beneng.desc: Gives hunters within 200 blocks a red-outlined Glowing effect (60s); grants self Speed I (10s)
item.skillcards.shuangni.desc: Gives the nearest hunter within 20 blocks Slowness IV and Mining Fatigue III (10s); they take 0.5 freeze damage per second
item.skillcards.paoxie.desc: Records 8 seconds of movement, then returns you to the casting spot; your health rewinds too (status effects do not)
item.skillcards.huskar.brief: Attacks cost health; the lower your health, the stronger you get
item.skillcards.huskar.desc: Each attack that lands costs 3% of your current health; below 80%/60%/40%/20% health you gain escalating Strength, Resistance, Attack Speed and Regeneration, for 60 seconds
item.skillcards.diaoyu.brief: Greatly boost resistance, but move sluggishly
item.skillcards.diaoyu.desc: Grants Resistance IV and Slowness III for 10 seconds
item.skillcards.qinglong.desc: Grants Jump Boost VI and Speed III for 30 seconds; fall damage is halved during the form
item.skillcards.guozai.brief: Greatly boost speed and attack speed, then crash
item.skillcards.guozai.desc: Grants Speed III and +30% Attack Speed for 30 seconds; afterwards Slowness I for 10 seconds
item.skillcards.ranhuo.brief: Release a burst of flame up close
item.skillcards.ranhuo.desc: Always castable. Releases flame in a cone: hit enemies burn for 8s and gain a Scorch layer; if they already have Scorch, all layers convert to 6 fire damage each, then one layer is added
item.skillcards.guiren.desc: Instantly gains 12 Blade Dance stacks; for 30s each melee hit adds one more stack (max 20), each stack gives +3% melee attack speed
item.skillcards.bizhang.desc: Temporarily deducts 80% of current health, granting equal Absorption for 6 seconds; the deducted health is returned afterwards
item.skillcards.diaoshe.brief: Arrow rain falls where your arrows land
item.skillcards.diaoshe.desc: For 30s, arrows from a crossbow or fully charged bow trigger arrow rain where they hit an entity, or at the landing point when they hit the ground (5x5, 20 blocks up, 3s), each arrow dealing fixed 6 damage
item.skillcards.gongshi.brief: The more movement speed, the more attack power
item.skillcards.gongshi.desc: Passive: each level of Speed on you adds +2 attack damage while moving
item.skillcards.zhenji.brief: Enemies that strike you are struck back
item.skillcards.zhenji.desc: Passive: permanently has the equivalent of Thorns IV - melee attackers take 2 damage
item.skillcards.zhongya.brief: Jump-attack critical hits deal more damage
item.skillcards.zhongya.desc: Passive: critical hit multiplier raised from 1.5 to 2.0
item.skillcards.xushi.brief: No attacks for a while; your next hit doubles
item.skillcards.xushi.desc: Passive: after 20 seconds without landing melee damage, your next melee attack deals double damage
item.skillcards.yuanman.brief: Stronger attacks while in good shape
item.skillcards.yuanman.desc: Passive: while above 80% max health, your attacks deal +2 damage
item.skillcards.shaobing.brief: Shooting enemies below you deals more damage
item.skillcards.shaobing.desc: Passive: thrown attacks or shots that hit lower targets deal +2 damage
item.skillcards.esha.brief: The more negative effects, the stronger your vitality
item.skillcards.esha.desc: Passive: for each negative effect on you, gain one level of Regeneration
item.skillcards.beishi.brief: Extra damage when attacking from behind
item.skillcards.beishi.desc: Passive: attacks against entities facing away from you deal 1.5x damage
item.skillcards.duochong.desc: Passive: bow or crossbow shots fire three times the arrows (tipped arrows duplicate as the same tipped arrows)
item.skillcards.falun.brief: Negative effects stop affecting you after a while
item.skillcards.falun.desc: Passive: after being continuously affected by a negative effect for 30 seconds, you become immune to it (same effect type, any level)
item.skillcards.dunzou.desc: Passive: when you gain invisibility, gain Speed II and Jump Boost III (30s, does not stack with other sources)
item.skillcards.kuangwu.brief: Damage builds up as you swing fast
item.skillcards.kuangwu.desc: Passive: each melee hit adds a Blade Dance stack; every 4 stacks convert to one Wild Sword (+1 melee damage each); no stacks for 1.5s clears them
item.skillcards.feixue.brief: Attacks cost health but ignite enemies
item.skillcards.feixue.desc: Passive: each attack that lands costs 3% of your current health and ignites the target for 4 seconds; if the target has no Scorch, one layer is added
global.skillcards.dance: [Global: Blade Dance] +3% melee attack speed per stack (max 20); lose 1 stack every 3s without stacking
global.skillcards.kuangjian: [Global: Wild Sword] +1 melee damage per stack (max 5); cleared after 1.5s without a Blade Dance stack
global.skillcards.scorch: [Global: Scorch] +1 fire damage taken while burning per stack; auto +1 stack every 3s while burning (max 5)
